NELDA HOWTON'S PLEADING IN SUPPORT OF KEVIN KENNEDY AND JOHN BURROWS' REQUEST FOR INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION AND FORENSIC AUDIT
TO THE HONORABLE PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION OF TEXAS AND ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:
Intervenor Nelda Howton, appearing pro se, files this pleading in support of Kevin Kennedy and John Burrows' request for an independent investigation and forensic audit. Before a project of this magnitude is approved, the principal information used to justify it should be capable of neutral, independent verification.
I.  INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION
The Commission is being asked to rely on forecasts, models, source data, cost assumptions, planning judgments, and conclusions concerning reliability and consumer benefits. An independent review would allow a neutral party to determine whether that information is complete, traceable to its source, reproducible, and supported by the underlying data.
This request does not presume fraud, misconduct, or wrongdoing. Its purpose is to replace speculation with verification by determining what information was used, what assumptions were made, whether the calculations can be replicated, and whether material information was omitted or changed.
II.  PUBLIC INTEREST
Landowners and ratepayers will live with the consequences of the Commission's decision. Independent verification would strengthen the reliability of that decision, protect the integrity of the process, and promote public confidence regardless of the ultimate outcome.
III.  PRAYER
Nelda Howton respectfully requests that the Commission and the Administrative Law Judges support and preserve Kennedy and Burrows' request for an independent investigation and forensic audit; require preservation of the underlying records, native data, models, and calculations necessary for meaningful review; and, if another governmental body must conduct or authorize such review, refer or recommend the request to the proper authority. She further requests all other relief to which she may be entitled.
Respectfully submitted,
/s/ Nelda Howton
NELDA HOWTON
Intervenor, Pro Se
PUC Docket No. 59475
Date: September 18, 2026
CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
I certify that a true and correct copy of the foregoing pleading is being served on all parties of record in accordance with the applicable orders and rules governing service in this proceeding on September 18, 2026.
/s/ Nelda Howton
